questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Pir Panjal range separates which two regions of J&K?
questions.explanation: The Pir Panjal range runs between the Kashmir Valley (north) and the Jammu region (south), forming a natural barrier. 'Kashmir Valley and Ladakh' is wrong — the Great Himalayas/Zanskar range separates those. 'Jammu and Punjab' is wrong — the Shivalik hills form that boundary. 'Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh' is wrong — geographically inaccurate.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the Indus Waters Treaty (1960):

(i) It was signed between India and Pakistan with the World Bank as mediator.
(ii) Under the treaty, India received exclusive rights over the eastern rivers: Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej.
(iii) Pakistan received rights over the western rivers: Indus, Jhelum, and Chenab.
(iv) India cannot build any storage or run-of-river projects on the western rivers.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: The IWT was mediated by the World Bank (i correct), eastern rivers to India (ii correct), western rivers to Pakistan (iii correct). (iv) is wrong because India CAN build run-of-river projects on western rivers with certain restrictions — the treaty allows limited use, not zero use. Option 2 includes (iv). Option 3 excludes (iii). Option 4 includes (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The Dal Lake in Srinagar has been shrinking over the decades.
Reason (R): Encroachments, siltation, sewage inflow, and growth of weeds have reduced the lake's area significantly.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: Dal Lake has indeed been shrinking (A correct). The causes are encroachments, siltation, sewage, and weed proliferation (R correct and directly explains why the lake is shrinking). Option 2 is wrong because R gives the exact reasons for A. Option 3 is wrong because R is factually correct. Option 4 is wrong because A is correct.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following districts of J&K with their administrative headquarters:

Column I:
(a) Kupwara
(b) Poonch
(c) Kishtwar
(d) Shopian

Column II:
(i) Shopian town
(ii) Kupwara town
(iii) Poonch town
(iv) Kishtwar town

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Kupwara district HQ is Kupwara town (ii). Poonch district HQ is Poonch town (iii). Kishtwar district HQ is Kishtwar town (iv). Shopian district HQ is Shopian town (i). Option 2 swaps Kupwara and Poonch. Option 3 swaps Poonch and Kishtwar. Option 4 swaps Kupwara and Kishtwar.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are traditional handicrafts of J&K?

(i) Pashmina shawl weaving
(ii) Papier-mâché work
(iii) Walnut wood carving
(iv) Chanderi silk weaving

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Pashmina weaving (i), Papier-mâché (ii), and Walnut wood carving (iii) are all traditional J&K crafts. Chanderi silk (iv) is wrong — it's from Chanderi in Madhya Pradesh, not J&K. Option 2 includes (iv). Option 3 excludes (ii). Option 4 includes (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Darbar Move' practice in J&K involves the shifting of government between:
questions.explanation: The Darbar Move shifts the civil secretariat between Jammu (winter, November-April) and Srinagar (summer, May-October). 'Srinagar and Leh' is wrong — Leh is in Ladakh UT. 'Jammu and Leh' is wrong — government doesn't shift to Leh. 'Srinagar and Anantnag' is wrong — Anantnag is not a capital.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the history of J&K:

(i) The Instrument of Accession was signed by Maharaja Hari Singh on 26 October 1947.
(ii) The UN-mandated ceasefire came into effect on 1 January 1949.
(iii) The Simla Agreement of 1972 converted the ceasefire line into the Line of Control.
(iv) Article 370 was abrogated on 5 August 2019.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: Maharaja signed accession on 26 Oct 1947 (i correct). Ceasefire on 1 Jan 1949 (ii correct). Simla Agreement 1972 created LoC (iii correct). Article 370 abrogated on 5 Aug 2019 (iv correct). Option 2 excludes (iv). Option 3 excludes (ii) and (iii). Option 4 excludes (i).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Hemis Monastery, famous for its annual masked dance festival, is located in:
questions.explanation: Hemis Monastery is in Hemis, Leh district, Ladakh — famous for the Hemis Festival (mask dance). 'Kashmir Valley' is wrong — no such monastery there. 'Jammu' is wrong — different region. 'Doda' is wrong — it's in Jammu division.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): J&K is the largest producer of saffron in India.
Reason (R): The karewa soils of Pampore area in Kashmir provide ideal conditions for saffron cultivation with their well-drained, elevated plateau characteristics.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: J&K produces nearly all of India's saffron (A correct). The karewa soils in Pampore are uniquely suited for saffron with their drainage and elevation (R correct and explains why J&K dominates saffron production). Option 2 is wrong because R explains the geographic/soil reason behind A. Option 3 is wrong because R is correct. Option 4 is wrong because A is correct.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The total number of districts in J&K Union Territory (as of 2024) is:
questions.explanation: J&K UT has 20 districts (10 in Kashmir division, 10 in Jammu division). '22' is wrong — that was the pre-2019 number including Ladakh districts. '18' is wrong — fewer than actual. '24' is wrong — too many.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following rivers of J&K with their tributaries:

Column I:
(a) Jhelum
(b) Chenab
(c) Ravi
(d) Indus

Column II:
(i) Zanskar
(ii) Lidder
(iii) Tawi
(iv) Siul

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Lidder is a tributary of Jhelum (ii). Tawi is a tributary of Chenab (iii). Siul (Sewa) is a tributary of Ravi (iv). Zanskar is a tributary of Indus (i). Option 2 assigns Tawi to Jhelum. Option 3 assigns Siul to Chenab. Option 4 assigns Zanskar to Jhelum.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Mughal Road historically connects which two places?
questions.explanation: The Mughal Road connects Shopian (Kashmir Valley) to Rajouri/Bufliaz (Jammu division) via Pir Panjal. 'Srinagar to Leh' is wrong — that's NH-1. 'Jammu to Srinagar via Banihal' is wrong — that's NH-44. 'Baramulla to Kupwara' is wrong — that's a different route within the Valley.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the economy of J&K:

(i) Horticulture contributes significantly to J&K's GDP.
(ii) Tourism is one of the major sources of income for J&K.
(iii) J&K is a major industrial state with heavy manufacturing units.
(iv) Sericulture (silk production) is practiced in parts of J&K.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: Horticulture (apples, dry fruits) is a major GDP contributor (i correct). Tourism is vital to J&K's economy (ii correct). Sericulture is practiced in some areas (iv correct). (iii) is wrong — J&K is NOT a major industrial state; its economy is dominated by agriculture, horticulture, and services, not heavy manufacturing. Option 2 includes (iii). Option 3 excludes (iv). Option 4 includes (iii).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Amar Mahal Palace Museum is a famous heritage site located in:
questions.explanation: Amar Mahal Palace is located in Jammu city, overlooking the Tawi river — built in the 19th century for Raja Amar Singh. 'Srinagar' is wrong — it has Mughal gardens and houseboats, not this palace. 'Rajouri' is wrong — no such heritage site there. 'Anantnag' is wrong — it's in south Kashmir.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The Chenab river has the highest hydroelectric potential among J&K's rivers.
Reason (R): The Chenab flows through deep gorges with steep gradients in the mountainous terrain of the Jammu division, creating ideal conditions for hydropower generation.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: The Chenab has the highest hydroelectric potential in J&K (A correct). Its deep gorges and steep gradients in mountainous Jammu terrain create high head for power generation (R correct and explains why Chenab leads in hydropower). Option 2 is wrong because R directly explains A. Option 3 is wrong because R is correct. Option 4 is wrong because A is correct.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Which of the following national highways pass through J&K?

(i) NH-44 (Jammu to Srinagar)
(ii) NH-1 (Srinagar to Leh)
(iii) NH-44A (connecting Mughal Road)
(iv) NH-48 (Delhi to Chennai)

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: NH-44 (Jammu-Srinagar) passes through J&K (i correct). NH-1 connects Srinagar to Leh (ii correct). NH-44A connects Mughal Road (iii correct). NH-48 (iv) is wrong — it connects Delhi to Chennai via Rajasthan/Gujarat, nowhere near J&K. Option 2 includes (iv). Option 3 excludes (iii). Option 4 includes (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Shankaracharya Temple (Takht-e-Sulaiman) in Srinagar is situated on a hill at an elevation of approximately:
questions.explanation: Shankaracharya Temple sits on Shankaracharya Hill about 1,000 feet above the Srinagar valley floor (elevation ~1,876 m ASL). '3,000 feet' is wrong — far too high. '500 feet' is wrong — too low. '2,000 feet' is wrong — overestimate.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following historical rulers with their contributions to J&K:

Column I:
(a) Zain-ul-Abidin
(b) Lalitaditya Muktapida
(c) Avanti Varman
(d) Sultan Sikandar

Column II:
(i) Built the Martand Sun Temple
(ii) Known as 'Butshikan' (iconoclast)
(iii) Founded the city of Avantipora
(iv) Known as 'Budshah' — promoted religious tolerance

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Zain-ul-Abidin = Budshah, promoter of tolerance (iv). Lalitaditya built Martand Sun Temple (i). Avanti Varman founded Avantipora (iii). Sultan Sikandar was called Butshikan (ii). Option 2 swaps Zain-ul-Abidin and Lalitaditya. Option 3 swaps Lalitaditya and Avanti Varman. Option 4 swaps Zain-ul-Abidin and Sikandar.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Navreh' festival celebrated in J&K marks:
questions.explanation: Navreh is the Kashmiri Hindu/Pandit New Year, falling on Chaitra Shukla Pratipada. 'Start of harvesting' is wrong — harvesting is in autumn. 'Eid' is wrong — that's a different Islamic celebration. 'Dogra New Year' is wrong — Dogras celebrate Lohri/Baisakhi.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019:

(i) It bifurcated J&K state into two Union Territories.
(ii) J&K UT has a legislature, while Ladakh UT does not.
(iii) The Act came into effect on 31 October 2019.
(iv) The Act retained Article 370 in a modified form.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: The Act created two UTs (i correct), J&K UT has a legislature while Ladakh UT doesn't (ii correct), effective 31 Oct 2019 (iii correct). (iv) is wrong because Article 370 was effectively abrogated — all provisions were made inoperative; it was not retained in any form. Option 2 includes (iv). Option 3 excludes (ii). Option 4 includes (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: Fill in the blank: The __________ Pass connects Srinagar to Kargil and further to Leh on NH-1.
questions.explanation: Zoji La (3,528 m) is the pass on NH-1 between Srinagar and Kargil/Leh. 'Banihal' is wrong — that connects Jammu to Kashmir on NH-44. 'Pir Panjal' is wrong — that's a range, not a specific pass on NH-1. 'Rohtang' is wrong — it's in Himachal Pradesh.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Rajatarangini, a historical chronicle of Kashmir's kings, was written by:
questions.explanation: Rajatarangini (River of Kings) was composed by Kalhana in the 12th century (1148-1150 CE). 'Bilhana' is wrong — he wrote Vikramankadevacharita about the Chalukya king. 'Jonaraja' is wrong — he wrote a continuation of Rajatarangini, not the original. 'Abhinavagupta' is wrong — he was a philosopher of Kashmir Shaivism.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The Kashmir Valley receives snowfall during winter months.
Reason (R): Western disturbances originating from the Mediterranean region bring moisture-laden winds to the Kashmir Valley during winter.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: Kashmir receives heavy snowfall in winter (A correct). Western disturbances from the Mediterranean bring winter precipitation to the valley (R correct and explains the mechanism of winter snowfall). Option 2 is wrong because R directly explains why Kashmir gets winter snow. Option 3 is wrong because R is meteorologically correct. Option 4 is wrong because A is correct.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Bahu Fort' overlooking the river Tawi is a major historical monument of:
questions.explanation: Bahu Fort stands on the left bank of river Tawi in Jammu city, believed to be over 3,000 years old. 'Srinagar' is wrong — Tawi doesn't flow through Srinagar. 'Udhampur' is wrong — different town. 'Rajouri' is wrong — not on the Tawi.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following festivals of J&K with their significance:

Column I:
(a) Tulip Festival
(b) Hemis Festival
(c) Baisakhi
(d) Shikara Festival

Column II:
(i) Celebrated on Dal Lake to promote tourism
(ii) Spring flower bloom celebration in Srinagar
(iii) Buddhist masked dance festival in Ladakh
(iv) Harvest festival celebrated in Jammu region

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Tulip Festival celebrates spring blooms (ii). Hemis is a Buddhist masked dance festival (iii). Baisakhi is a harvest festival in Jammu region (iv). Shikara Festival is on Dal Lake for tourism (i). Option 2 swaps Tulip and Hemis. Option 3 swaps Hemis and Shikara. Option 4 swaps Tulip and Baisakhi.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The highest railway bridge in the world (Chenab Bridge) on the USBRL project is located between which two stations?
questions.explanation: The Chenab Bridge spans between Bakkal and Kauri stations in Reasi district at 359m height. 'Jammu and Udhampur' is wrong — that section is already operational. 'Banihal and Qazigund' is wrong — that's a tunnel section. 'Srinagar and Baramulla' is wrong — that section is on flat valley terrain.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the agriculture of J&K:

(i) Rice is the staple food crop of the Kashmir Valley.
(ii) Basmati rice is primarily grown in the R.S. Pura belt of Jammu.
(iii) Maize is an important kharif crop in the Jammu region.
(iv) J&K is India's largest producer of sugarcane.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: Rice is Kashmir's staple (i correct). Basmati in R.S. Pura belt (ii correct). Maize is key kharif crop in Jammu (iii correct). (iv) is wrong — UP and Maharashtra lead sugarcane; J&K barely grows it due to cold climate. Option 2 includes (iv). Option 3 excludes (ii). Option 4 includes (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Martand Sun Temple ruins are located near which town in Kashmir?
questions.explanation: The Martand Sun Temple (8th century, Lalitaditya era) is located near Mattan, Anantnag district. 'Srinagar' is wrong — it's about 60 km from Srinagar. 'Baramulla' is wrong — it's in north Kashmir, far from Anantnag. 'Pulwama' is wrong — different district.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): Apple cultivation in J&K is concentrated mainly in the districts of Shopian, Baramulla, and Kupwara.
Reason (R): These districts have the ideal temperate climate, altitude (1,500-2,700 m), and well-drained soil necessary for commercial apple growing.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: Shopian, Baramulla, and Kupwara are major apple-growing districts (A correct). Their temperate climate, elevation, and soil make them ideal for apples (R correct and explains why these specific districts dominate). Option 2 is wrong because R explains the geographic advantage. Option 3 is wrong because R is correct. Option 4 is wrong because A is correct.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Dogri' language was included in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution by which Amendment?
questions.explanation: Dogri was added to the Eighth Schedule by the 92nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003 along with Bodo, Maithili, and Santhali. '86th Amendment' is wrong — that dealt with Right to Education. '73rd Amendment' is wrong — that dealt with Panchayati Raj. '100th Amendment' is wrong — that dealt with land boundary with Bangladesh.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Which of the following lakes are located in the Kashmir Valley?

(i) Dal Lake
(ii) Wular Lake
(iii) Mansar Lake
(iv) Nagin Lake

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Dal Lake in Srinagar (i correct), Wular in Bandipora (ii correct), and Nagin (connected to Dal) in Srinagar (iv correct) are all in Kashmir Valley. Mansar Lake (iii) is wrong — it's located near Jammu in the Jammu division. Option 2 includes (iii). Option 3 excludes (iv). Option 4 includes (iii).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
The following data shows the installed capacity of major hydroelectric projects in J&K:

Salal → 690
Uri-I → 480
Dulhasti → 390
Kishanganga → 330
Uri-II → 240

What is the total installed capacity of all the listed projects?
questions.explanation: Total = 690+480+390+330+240 = 2,130 MW. '2,030 MW' is wrong — undercounts by 100. '1,890 MW' is wrong — excludes one project. '2,230 MW' is wrong — overcounts by 100.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Shikara' boats are traditionally associated with which water body in J&K?
questions.explanation: Shikaras are iconic gondola-style boats of Dal Lake, Srinagar, used for tourism and transport. 'Wular Lake' is wrong — it uses larger boats for fishing, not shikaras. 'Manasbal Lake' is wrong — limited tourism boats. 'Pangong Lake' is wrong — it's in Ladakh and too cold for regular boating.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following J&K districts with their Kashmir/Jammu division:

Column I:
(a) Pulwama
(b) Rajouri
(c) Ganderbal
(d) Kathua

Column II:
(i) Jammu division
(ii) Kashmir division
(iii) Kashmir division
(iv) Jammu division

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Pulwama is in Kashmir division (ii). Rajouri is in Jammu division (i). Ganderbal is in Kashmir division (iii). Kathua is in Jammu division (iv). Option 2 wrongly assigns Pulwama to Jammu. Option 3 wrongly assigns Ganderbal to Jammu. Option 4 mixes up all assignments.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Land Reforms Act' of J&K, which abolished landlordism, was enacted in:
questions.explanation: The Big Landed Estates Abolition Act was enacted in 1950 under Sheikh Abdullah's government, abolishing jagirdari and transferring land to tillers. '1947' is wrong — that year saw accession, not land reform. '1960' is wrong — reforms came much earlier. '1953' is wrong — Sheikh was dismissed that year.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about tourism in J&K:

(i) Gulmarg is famous for skiing and its gondola cable car.
(ii) Pahalgam is known as the 'Valley of Shepherds'.
(iii) Sonamarg is the base camp for the Amarnath Yatra.
(iv) Patnitop is a hill station in the Kashmir Valley.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: Gulmarg for skiing/gondola (i correct). Pahalgam = Valley of Shepherds (ii correct). Sonamarg is Amarnath base camp (iii correct). (iv) is wrong because Patnitop is in the JAMMU division (on Udhampur-Ramban road), not in the Kashmir Valley. Option 2 includes (iv). Option 3 excludes (iii). Option 4 includes (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: Fill in the blank: The __________ river is known as 'Vitasta' in ancient Sanskrit texts.
questions.explanation: The Jhelum was called 'Vitasta' in Sanskrit literature (Rajatarangini). 'Chenab' is wrong — it was called 'Asikni' in Vedic texts. 'Ravi' is wrong — it was called 'Parushni' or 'Iravati'. 'Indus' is wrong — it was called 'Sindhu'.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Jammu and Kashmir National Conference' was founded by:
questions.explanation: Sheikh Abdullah founded the National Conference in 1939 (renamed from Muslim Conference). 'Maharaja Hari Singh' is wrong — he was the ruler, not a party leader. 'Bakshi Ghulam Mohammad' is wrong — he succeeded Sheikh as PM of J&K. 'Pandit Nehru' is wrong — he was a national Congress leader.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The Jammu region has a sub-tropical climate in its lower areas.
Reason (R): The lower areas of Jammu division lie south of the Pir Panjal range at relatively low altitudes (300-600 m) and receive monsoon rainfall.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: Jammu's plains have a sub-tropical climate (A correct). Their location south of Pir Panjal at low altitude with monsoon exposure creates this climate (R correct and explains A). Option 2 is wrong because R explains the geographic factors behind A. Option 3 is wrong because R is correct. Option 4 is wrong because A is correct.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Hari Parbat Fort in Srinagar was built during whose reign?
questions.explanation: The outer wall of Hari Parbat Fort was built during Akbar's rule (1590s). 'Maharaja Ranbir Singh' is wrong — Dogra rulers made additions but didn't build it originally. 'Zain-ul-Abidin' is wrong — he ruled earlier (15th century). 'Ranjit Singh' is wrong — Sikhs captured it later but didn't build it.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Which of the following correctly describe features of the 'Karewa' formations in Kashmir?

(i) They are elevated tablelands/plateaus of lacustrine deposits.
(ii) They are primarily found in the Kashmir Valley.
(iii) They are ideal for saffron and almond cultivation.
(iv) They are volcanic rock formations.

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Karewas are elevated plateaus of ancient lake deposits (i correct), found in Kashmir Valley (ii correct), ideal for saffron/almonds (iii correct). (iv) is wrong — Karewas are LACUSTRINE (lake) deposits of clay/silt/sand, NOT volcanic formations. Option 2 includes (iv). Option 3 excludes (iii). Option 4 includes (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
The following data shows tourist arrivals in J&K over 4 years:

2019 → 151
2020 → 35
2021 → 67
2022 → 189

What was the percentage decrease in tourist arrivals from 2019 to 2020?
questions.explanation: Decrease = 151-35 = 116. Percentage = (116/151)×100 ≈ 76.8%. '50%' is wrong — that would need arrivals of 75.5. '65%' is wrong — that would need arrivals of ~53. '80%' is wrong — that would need arrivals of ~30.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Hazratbal Shrine in Srinagar is famous because:
options: It houses a relic believed to be the hair of Prophet Muhammad
It is the burial place of Sheikh Abdullah
It is the largest mosque in South Asia
It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan
questions.correctAnswer: It houses a relic believed to be the hair of Prophet Muhammad
questions.explanation: Hazratbal (Majestic Place) is revered for housing the Moi-e-Muqaddas (holy relic of Prophet Muhammad's hair). 'Burial of Sheikh Abdullah' is wrong — he is buried at Mazaar-e-Quaid in Srinagar, not Hazratbal. 'Largest mosque' is wrong — it's significant for the relic, not size. 'Built by Shah Jahan' is wrong — it has a different history.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the Amarnath Yatra:

(i) The natural ice Shiva Lingam forms in the Amarnath Cave due to freezing water dripping from the cave ceiling.
(ii) The yatra takes place annually during July-August (Shravan month).
(iii) There are two main routes: Baltal (Sonamarg) and Pahalgam (Chandanwari).
(iv) The Amarnath Cave is located at an altitude of approximately 12,756 feet.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: The ice lingam forms from dripping/freezing water (i correct). Yatra occurs July-August in Shravan (ii correct). Two routes exist: Baltal and Pahalgam (iii correct). The cave is at ~12,756 feet (3,888 m) altitude (iv correct). Option 2 excludes (iv). Option 3 excludes (ii) and (iii). Option 4 excludes (i).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The Lal Ded (Lalleshwari) is an iconic figure of J&K associated with:
options: First woman IAS officer from J&K
questions.explanation: Lal Ded (c. 1320-1392) was a Kashmiri mystic poetess who composed vakhs (verses) blending Shaivite philosophy. 'First woman IAS' is wrong — that's a modern figure. 'Freedom fighter from Dogra dynasty' is wrong — she predated Dogra rule by centuries. 'Modern-day activist' is wrong — she lived in the 14th century.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Match the following languages with the regions where they are predominantly spoken in J&K:

Column I:
(a) Kashmiri
(b) Dogri
(c) Gojri
(d) Pahari

Column II:
(i) Jammu plains
(ii) Kashmir Valley
(iii) Pir Panjal region (Rajouri, Poonch)
(iv) Gujjar/Bakerwal communities

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: Kashmiri in Kashmir Valley (ii). Dogri in Jammu plains (i). Gojri among Gujjar/Bakerwal tribes (iv). Pahari in Pir Panjal region like Rajouri/Poonch (iii). Option 2 swaps Kashmiri and Dogri. Option 3 swaps Dogri and Gojri. Option 4 assigns Kashmiri to Pir Panjal.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
The following data shows apple production in J&K over recent years:

2020-21 → 18.5
2021-22 → 21.2
2022-23 → 19.8
2023-24 → 23.5

In which year was the highest year-on-year increase in production?
questions.explanation: 2021-22 increase: 21.2-18.5=2.7. 2022-23: 19.8-21.2=-1.4 (decrease). 2023-24: 23.5-19.8=3.7. The highest increase is 3.7 lakh MT in 2023-24. '2021-22' is wrong — increase was only 2.7 (less than 3.7). '2020-21' is wrong — no previous year data given for comparison. '2022-23' is wrong — it was a decrease.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Nubra Valley' in Ladakh is famous for:
options: Double-humped Bactrian camels and sand dunes
questions.correctAnswer: Double-humped Bactrian camels and sand dunes
questions.explanation: Nubra Valley (Hunder) is famous for its cold desert, sand dunes, and rare double-humped Bactrian camels. 'Apple orchards' is wrong — apples grow in Kashmir Valley. 'Saffron fields' is wrong — saffron is in Pampore, Kashmir. 'Walnut plantations' is wrong — walnuts are in Kashmir districts.

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the Line of Control (LoC) in J&K:

(i) The LoC was established after the Simla Agreement of 1972.
(ii) It replaced the earlier Ceasefire Line of 1949.
(iii) The LoC runs through J&K from a point north-east of Kargil to a point south of Poonch.
(iv) The LoC is an internationally recognized border.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: LoC established after Simla Agreement 1972 (i correct). It replaced the 1949 ceasefire line (ii correct). It extends from northeast of Kargil area to south of Poonch (iii correct). (iv) is wrong because the LoC is NOT an internationally recognized border — it is a de facto boundary, not a settled international frontier. Option 2 includes (iv). Option 3 excludes (iii). Option 4 includes (iv).

questions.subject: C
questions.questionText: The 'Chinar' tree (Platanus orientalis) is the State tree of J&K. It is primarily found in:
questions.explanation: The Chinar (Bouin) tree thrives in the temperate climate of the Kashmir Valley and is iconic to the region. 'Jammu plains' is wrong — the sub-tropical climate doesn't suit Chinars. 'Ladakh plateau' is wrong — too cold and arid. 'Siwalik hills' is wrong — different vegetation zone.
